description: 只读既有NoSIG E30的L6300/V27000缓存特征，L-only类别平衡共享RX方向、身份子空间投影、跨类留一与V方向迁移；零训练/模型/IQ/U/target。
authorization: 用户2026-10-26明确后续改为优化REPL，吸收正收益；既有去SIG_TIME和原三目标/三seed要求保持。

code.environment: verified local Phase1 Python/NumPy; CPU2 threads; cached feature algebra only

data.dataset: same original F0 VALIDATED_ONCE roles and physical IDs
data.representation: frozen normalized joint160 source features; raw and normalized average of twelve G views
data.contract_ref: features_complete.json.source_contract of known NoSIG E30 source graph feature extraction
data.label_map_ref: original F0 six registered default-head classes

roles.L_s: 6300 frozen features and visible labels only; sole estimator input
roles.V: 27000 frozen features/visible source labels; diagnostic only, never forms candidate statistics

data.train_ratio: no training; original roles unchanged; physical IDs/order checked against existing contract
data.validation_ref: existing VALIDATED_ONCE handles, unchanged; Phase1 capsule/split p2 handles not applicable

permissions.claim_scope: necessary geometry only; not default-head accuracy, actual G scene accuracy, trained student or target success

sources: known source-only NoSIG E30 raw/restored_mean12 L/V feature caches
checkpoint.contract_check_ref: features_complete.json and exact role IDs/order; same original VALIDATED_ONCE source split
checkpoint.provenance_verdict: upstream NoSIG E30 default-head source lineage already verified; no weight inheritance in this analysis
checkpoint.selection_rule: fixed raw AND restored_mean12 protectedRXfraction>=.05/locoCos>.1/locoPositive>.5/VtransferCos>.1; no automatic student training

execution.gpu_policy: CPU only; no remote execution or GPU worker
execution.stop_rule: invalid/missing source role/order/nonfinite/missingcell stops analysis; preserve cached features/upstream and immutable result; no threshold tuning or automatic student

expected_artifacts: two complete source geometry summaries with exact counts and L-only class/RX statistics
raw/Gmean12 identity-protected RX energy, six-class leave-one-out and independent V direction transfer
fixed necessary-condition result, immutable complete.json and public summary; no checkpoint/IQ/U/target/model or student training

metrics_plan.selection: fixed before results; no alpha or threshold scan; failure rules out only shared additive RX formulation
metrics_plan.truth_policy: L labels fit nonparametric source statistics; V labels only evaluation; U/target closed

rows.method: L-balanced RX offsets minus L class subspace
rows.seed_notes: upstream student seed01; fixed split/data/augmentation inherited from feature cache; no new randomness, optimizer, support or query; not three seeds
rows.budget_ref: L6300/V27000 frozen features in two views; model/IQ/U/target/updates0
expected_artifacts: two complete source geometry summaries with exact counts and L-only class/RX statistics
raw/Gmean12 identity-protected RX energy, six-class leave-one-out and independent V direction transfer
fixed necessary-condition result, immutable complete.json and public summary; no checkpoint/IQ/U/target/model or student training

notes: No additional real-checkpoint smoke: no model/checkpoint/IQ machinery consumed; cached source feature analysis only.

New student matrix requires separate actual objective/smoke/preregistration; not started by this run.
